कुरुक्षेत्र के युद्ध में भगवान श्रीकृष्ण द्वारा अर्जुन को दिया गया परम ज्ञान। 18 chapters, 700 shlokas — eternal wisdom for modern life.

8K Divine Art: The Sacred Union: Ardhanarishvara

The Sacred Union: Ardhanarishvara

This divine manifestation represents the inseparable unity of masculine and feminine energies, where Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati merge into a single, harmonious form. It symbolizes the non-dual nature of the universe, illustrating that creation exists through the perfect balance of consciousness and primordial energy.
